cues.zh: 這裡也設一個。

cues.en: We're going to build our agents that have our tool, and we're going to ask, what is the Wi-Fi password?
cues.zh: 建立帶有工具的代理程式，再問：Wi-Fi 密碼是什麼？

cues.en: When we ask that, the AI will say, I need to ask my tool.
cues.zh: AI 看到問題，就會決定需要詢問工具。

cues.en: It will say, what is the Wi-Fi password?
cues.zh: 把「Wi-Fi 密碼是什麼？」傳給工具。

cues.en: It will search for that, give back the three most records, the first record hopefully being our what is the Wi-Fi password to the office.
cues.zh: 搜尋後取得最相關的三筆，第一筆應該就是辦公室 Wi-Fi 密碼。

cues.en: While the two others are probably not valuable to us, but since the word office was here,
cues.zh: 另外兩筆可能對回答沒有幫助，但因為這裡也有 office 相關內容，

cues.en: this is the second one that was closest to that in vector space, and this is the third one.
cues.zh: 它們分別是在向量空間中第二近與第三近的結果。

cues.en: So we're essentially just giving the LLM this extra information, as if we were to give it in the prompt or the system information.
cues.zh: 因此只是把額外資訊交給 LLM，就像放進提示詞或系統資訊。

cues.en: And based on that, it will do its response that the Wi-Fi password is 42.
cues.zh: 根據這些資料，它就能回答 Wi-Fi 密碼。

cues.en: That's actually everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 全部流程其實就是這樣。

cues.en: We went from absolutely nothing, not even having a Azure AI research, deploying those models, writing the code.
cues.zh: 我們從完全沒有開始，甚至還沒有 Azure AI 資源，接著部署模型、撰寫程式。

cues.en: And yes, this is just a sample, but in real life, you will just have more data here.
cues.zh: 這只是範例，實際上只會有更多資料，

cues.en: And use none in memory, but SQL Server, SQLite, Azure AI, Cosmos DB, or any of the other vector stores.
cues.zh: 並改用非記憶體儲存，例如 SQL Server、SQLite、Azure AI Search、Cosmos DB，或其他向量儲存區。

cues.en: And the embedding itself might happen via Google Gemini instead of OpenAI.
cues.zh: 嵌入向量也可以改由 Google Gemini，而不是 OpenAI 產生。

cues.en: That's what we're covering in the other videos that are the companion videos to this.
cues.zh: 這些會在本系列其他搭配影片介紹。

cues.en: But for now, thank you for attending and see you in the next one. Bye.
cues.zh: 目前先感謝觀看，下一支影片見，再見。
